Ather 450S
Why this one

What stands out

Same chassis and brakes

Identical frame, suspension and dual disc brakes to the 450X. The difference is the screen, the motor tune and software.

DeepView display

A 7-inch non-touch display that stays readable in Chennai's midday sun.

Up to 161 km IDC

The 3.5 kWh pack gives the same IDC range as the 450X — about 130 km in real riding.

Up to 10-year battery warranty

3 years as standard, extendable up to 10 years / 1,00,000 km — same as the rest of the range.

Colours

5 finishes to choose from

Colour preview

Colour availability varies with stock. Call us to check what is on the floor this week.
